results.description: Popular Twitch streamer Ludwig has surprised fans with an unexpected appearance in Road to Empress 2, a Chinese live-action visual novel. The collaboration was announced on July 29, 2026, revealing that Ludwig plays a royal envoy called the Prince of Fuling. His new look, featuring long blonde hair and elegant blue royal clothing, quickly became a talking point online. During a livestream, Ludwig reacted to his character with humour and said he looked completely different. Players can unlock his appearance by progressing through the game's main story. Ludwig joins Road to Empress 2 with surprise role as Prince of Fuling Ludwig is the latest content creator to appear in Road to Empress 2, a Chinese live-action visual novel where players must make smart choices to survive palace life and court politics. In the game, Ludwig plays an envoy known as the Prince of Fuling. His character wears flowing blue robes with detailed embroidery, black arm guards, a gold belt, and a jewelled headpiece. However, the biggest change is his long blonde hair, which gives him a very different look from what viewers usually see on his Twitch streams.
